entries.text: Row-count validation now fails a query whose expected count cannot be found in a benchmark that has reference answers, and labels queries with no reference answers as UNVALIDATED in results, summaries and the submission validator instead of counting them as passed
Queries that use QUALIFY and ORDER BY now keep the ORDER BY on the outermost SELECT for Presto, Trino and Athena, so TPC-Havoc 1_v8 returns rows in the canonical order
